answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can require every identity to lock a refundable stake before it earns rewards. Like a velvet rope that only opens after a deposit, the bond makes each fake identity cost real capital, while honest agents get theirs back. A zephyr of new accounts cannot flood the meadow of rewards, because creating a thousand sock puppets means locking a thousand stakes, and proven duplicates lose their deposits to slashing. The attacker pays linearly per identity while the defender verifies cheaply.
